notes: Formulation assigned by troop (3 of 11 troops got 8 mg), called a field test, so non-randomized trial. Mean doses per patient is a count per person compared with a t-test; recorded as count/rate, continuous is defensible.
view_issues: Table 'RR' values match odds ratios from the counts (survival 99.0% vs 99.2% yields 0.81; withdrawal 37.6% vs 19.4% yields 2.51), not log-binomial risk ratios (would be ~1.00 and ~1.94). Article notes it was corrected after publication.
